title: webapp-deploy executor
description: Deploy a build artifact to an Azure Web App with the Azure CLI. Requires an existing `az login` session.

name.description: Name of the Azure Web App.

resourceGroup.description: Name of the resource group that contains the Web App.

srcPath.description: Artifact to deploy (for example a .zip, .war or .jar file), relative to the workspace root.

subscription.description: Name or ID of the Azure subscription that contains the Web App. Always passed, so the deploy never falls back to the CLI's default subscription.
